name: Geo170K
description: Geo170K is a large-scale multimodal geometry dataset containing over 170K geometric image-caption and question-answer pairs designed to enable large language models to solve geometric problems by understanding image input.
reputation: A newer geometry-focused multimodal dataset that has seen some use in evaluating LMMs on geometric understanding, but is not yet a widely standardized benchmark.
notes: Dataset is constructed by augmenting existing data to address limitations of current multimodal LLMs in geometric problem solving.
